summary: Algonquin Power & Utilities filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing consent solicitations for three series of subordinated notes: US$350M 6.20% Series 2019-A, US$750M 4.750% Series 2022-B, and C$400M 5.250% Series 2022-A. Consent fees are US$0.025 per US$25 (2019-A), US$1.00 per US$1,000 (2022-B), and C$1.00 per C$1,000 (2022-A). The proposed amendments delete the automatic conversion article converting notes into preferred shares upon bankruptcy/insolvency events. Watch for quorum and consent thresholds, and any rating or spread implications from removing the equity-conversion backstop.
